1: The container does not set potentially sensitive environment variables
The container sets potentially sensitive environment variables

'$schema': http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema
type: object
properties:
  env:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      anyOf:
        - not:
            required: ["value"]
        - required: ["name", "value"]
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
              '$comment': These environment variable names will be disallowed.
              allOf:
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)^AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY$'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)^GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS$'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)^AZURE_.+KEY$'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)^OCI_CLI_KEY_CONTENT$'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)password'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)token'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)bearer'
                - not:
                    pattern: '^(?!STAKATER).*(?i)secret'
                  '$comment': This allows variable names not excluded above.
                - pattern: '(?i).*'
            value:
              type: string
              '$comment': These environment variable values will be disallowed.
              allOf:
              - not:
                  '$comment': This matches variations like begin private key, begin rsa private key ...
                  pattern: '(?i)\s*-BEGIN\s+.PRIVATE KEY-\s'
        - required: ["name", "valueFrom"]
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
            valueFrom:
              type: object
The ConfigMap does not contain potentially sensitive content in its keys and values
Potentially sensitive content is detected in the ConfigMap keys or values

'$schema': http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema
type: object
required: ["metadata"]
properties:
  metadata:
    required: ["name"]
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
  data:
    type: object
    propertyNames:
      '$comment': These ConfigMap keys will be disallowed.
      allOf:
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)^AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY$'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)^GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS$'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)^AZURE_.+KEY$'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)^OCI_CLI_KEY_CONTENT$'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)password'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)token'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)bearer'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)secret(?!.*namespace)'
          '$comment': This allows ConfigMap keys not excluded above.
        - pattern: '(?i).*'
    additionalProperties:
      '$comment': These ConfigMap values will be disallowed.
      allOf:
      - not:
          '$comment': THis matches variations like begin private key, begin rsa private key ...
          pattern: '(?i)\s*-BEGIN\s+.*PRIVATE KEY-\s*'

---
directory: /media/music
library: /data/library.db
import:
  move: true
  from_scratch: true
asciify_paths: true
group_albums: true
per_disc_numbering: true
paths:
  default: "$albumartist/[%if{$year,$year,0000}] $album%aunique{}/%if{$multidisc,$disc-}$track - $title"
  albumtype:soundtrack: "000-soundtracks/$album [%if{$year,$year,0000}]%aunique{}/%if{$multidisc,$disc-}$track - $title"
  comp: "000-compilations/$album [%if{$year,$year,0000}]%aunique{}/%if{$multidisc,$disc-}$track - %if{$artist,$artist - }$title"
  singleton: "000-non-album/$artist/$title"
plugins:
  - albumtypes # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/albumtypes.html
  - discogs # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/discogs.html
  - duplicates # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en//stable/plugins/duplicates.html
  - extrafiles # https://github.com/Holzhaus/beets-extrafiles
  - fetchart # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/fetchart.html
  - ftintitle # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/ftintitle.html
  - inline # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/inline.html
  - lastgenre # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/lastgenre.html
  - lyrics # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/lyrics.html
  - missing # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/missing.html
  - mbsync # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/mbsync.html
  - scrub # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/scrub.html
  - web # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/web.html
discogs:
  source_weight: 0.0
  user_token: ${SECRET_DISCOGS_PAT}
extrafiles:
  patterns:
      all:
        - '*.*'
fetchart:
  cautious: true
  sources: itunes *
item_fields:
  multidisc: 1 if disctotal > 1 else 0
lastgenre:
  canonical: yes
lyrics:
  fallback: ''
  synced: true
fuzzy:
web:
  reverse_proxy: true
  host: 0.0.0.0
